original_card.acceptance_gate: An exact arbitrary-input identity, source/target frame availability and restoration at the chosen cut, plus the complete channel+correction+idle/hosting bill or an explicit favorable bound. The native channel alone is not a supplier. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier.
